messages:
nina (docs): FYI we're putting out a short public notice next Wednesday: 'Python SDK: surface cleanup + codemods' — preview doc is live in staging.

raj (sdk): Summary: removing the legacy arg-coercion behavior. We'll release a codemod that converts the top 10 breaking patterns automatically. Codemod repo: https://git.internal/redwood/codemods/sdk-py.

harper (product): Timeline: announcement -> 60 days -> extended 30 for Dedicated on request -> final removal. We'll include a support request form link.

mike (devex): I'll host three migration office hours and record them. Also shipping an annotated example PR generator for repos that opt-in.

ana (legal): small correction: call me ana not nana :) Also legal reviewed privacy text for the codemod; ensure telemetry is opt-out and documented.

ana (legal): approved copy: "The codemod collects anonymized match counts and non-sensitive stack hashes. To opt out set REDWOOD_CODEMOD_TELEMETRY=0."

raj (sdk): Example before->after we'll include in the announcement:

Before: client.generate(prompt=['a','b'])
After: client.generate(prompts=['a','b'])

We'll add helper shims in compat package for edge cases.

ci-bot: docs staging build: green (sha: ffe7a1). Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/docs/2145678901

nina (docs): Please review the staging page and flag any samples that still use old implicit shapes. I'm running a grep pass and will open doc PRs for trivial fixes.

harper (product): Support plan: create FAQ + canned responses + dedicated Dedicated-extension request flow. Notify account teams per high-usage customers.

mike (devex): codemod usage (opt-in autofix):
redwood-codemod apply --repo path/to/repo --preview > changes.diff
redwood-codemod apply --repo path/to/repo --autofix

nina (docs): final: reviewers: @raj @mike @ana @harper. If no blockers, publish Wed 10am PT and send the changelog entry.

raj (sdk): acked. I'll push the codemod release and example PRs today.
